name: Anchorage Municipality, AK
findings: Anchorage Municipality has 1,311 nonprofit organizations. 578 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 473 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Anchorage Municipality has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 18 arts and cultural organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.
